description: Owner-directed immediate publication of exactly UA-0017 and UA-0018. Stable non-secret task120-completed ledgers derived from the workflow identity may persist solely as replay-safe idempotency evidence. Scheduled-task fallback is forbidden. If trigger stop cannot be confirmed, preserve the task-owned transport and ledger without further remote mutation and return a blocked result for manual recovery.
